Delegates Walk Out During Netanyahu's UN Address

During Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's address at the UN General Assembly, dozens of delegates walked out of the meeting in protest. Some reports indicate that Netanyahu responded to the walkout by calling the delegates "moral cowards." One report mentioned that Netanyahu also used his address to highlight ties with Donald Trump and "harangue everyone else."
